name: Turning It Over To God
overview: Scripture encourages believers to entrust their difficulties and decisions fully to God, recognizing Him as a steadfast refuge and source of strength in times of trouble. Trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly means not relying on our own understanding, for while we may plan our way, it is God who ultimately directs our steps. By casting our burdens upon Him, we are assured of His sustaining power and protection, ensuring that the righteous will not be shaken.
